subject: Milestone agreement + audit log retention pricing (Crestview)
messages:
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@crestview.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@crestview.com>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Intro: evaluation window & compliance pricing questions

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Crestview is interested in Redwood but we need a clear mutual plan to move through the evaluation and procurement windows. Two quick asks to kick off:

1) Can you share a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can use internally that ties acceptance milestones to commercial terms? Specifically: evaluation windows, acceptance criteria, and proposed ramp/commit milestones.
2) We need explicit line-item pricing for the compliance/security add-ons: audit log streaming, extended retention (90/365 days), and the premium admin controls module. Our security team needs these numbers for procurement.

If you can send a draft MAP and a one-page commercial summary with those add-on prices, we can route to Procurement and Legal. Target for procurement to respond: mid-May.

Thanks —
Emma Johnson
Director, Cloud Platform Security
Crestview Bank
[Attachment: internal-security-reqs.pdf (pdf)]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@crestview.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-01T12:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro: evaluation window & compliance pricing questions

Emma —

Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a draft MAP and our standard eval playbook. High level summary below; full details are in the attachments.

Draft proposal (high level):
- 2-week exploratory trial (non-prod) — Redwood provides hosted evaluation tokens and a small test model for functional validation.
- 4-week extended eval (stability & scale) — run your sample traffic, we provide guidance on batching and KV cache config. Acceptance = 95% service availability for the test window and no critical security findings in the pen test checklist.
- Ramp/commit milestones: if acceptance criteria met, Crestview can commit to a 12-month Dedicated plan with staged minimum monthly GPU hours: Month 1-3: baseline X, Month 4-12: ramp to 3X baseline. Discount schedule tied to annual commit.

Compliance add-ons (estimates):
- Audit log streaming (near-real-time): $1,500/month
- Extended retention 90d: $650/month; 365d: $2,200/month
- Premium admin controls (SAML SSO + granular RBAC + HSM integration): one-time setup $9,000 + $700/month

Next steps I suggest: 1) review the attached MAP and eval playbook, 2) quick sync — 30 minutes to confirm acceptance criteria and PO timeline. Karthik is copied to coordinate the commercial terms.

Attachments: Crestview_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf; Redwood_Eval_Playbook.xlsx

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T08:30:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: Crestview commercial thoughts on MAP and add-ons

Grace / Neha —

Quick internal note based on Emma's ask and Grace's draft:
- Pricing above looks reasonable as a starting point but recommend we tie discount bands to annualized committed spend, not just GPU hours. Simpler for procurement. Proposed bands: 10% @ $120k/yr, 18% @ $250k/yr, 25% @ $500k/yr.
- For audit logs/retention: offer a bundled discount if they take both streaming + 365d retention (bundle price = $2,800/month) — gives us upsell while making procurement math cleaner.
- Ramp enforcement: include a 60-day cure period before any carve-outs for missed ramp.
- Approval: I can approve up to a 15% concession. Anything beyond needs Neha sign-off.

I'll prepare a 1-pager commercial summary we can send as Rev A. Grace: can you mark acceptance criteria in the MAP (pass/fail gates) so procurement has hard dates?

Karthik
Head of Sales (Enterprise), Redwood Inference
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@crestview.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@crestview.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T14:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Milestone agreement + audit log retention pricing (Crestview)

Grace —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifying items from Security & Procurement:

- Security wants the audit log stream to include integrity hashes and be compatible with our SIEM (Splunk). Will that be supported out-of-the-box or via an integration?
- Procurement wants the commercial summary in a tabular line-item format (monthly vs one-time), and the bundle you mentioned explicitly called out.
- PO timeline: procurement expects to issue a PO by 2026-05-20 if we can get a signed comms/terms sheet by 2026-05-12. Can you meet that window?

If you can update the MAP with the exact acceptance gate wording and send a Rev A commercial one-pager, we'll circulate internally.

Emma
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@crestview.com>, Procurement <procurement@crestview.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T10:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Milestone agreement + audit log retention pricing (Crestview)

Emma / team —

Thanks — attached is Rev B: a one-page commercial summary plus an updated MAP with explicit pass/fail gates. Short answers inline then the attachments:

- Audit log integration: Redwood supports structured JSON log export with SHA-256 integrity hashes; we provide a Splunk HEC-ready connector (out-of-the-box). We can ship a config template for your SIEM team during the eval window.

- Commercial Rev B (highlights):
  * Audit log streaming: $1,400/month (reduced)
  * Extended retention 365d: $2,500/month
  * Bundle (streaming + 365d): $2,900/month (5% bundle discount)
  * Premium admin controls: $8,500 one-time setup + $650/month
  * Commit/discount schedule (by annualized ARR): 12% @ $120k, 20% @ $250k, 27% @ $500k
  * Ramp cure period: 60 days; staged ramp milestones included in MAP

- Timeline: We can deliver Rev B and the signed comms/terms sheet by 2026-05-12 provided Procurement confirms the PO timeline and final list of signatories by 2026-05-10. DocuSign and HubSpot links below.

Attachments: Commercial_Summary_Crestview_RevB.pdf; Crestview_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (updated)

Next steps: 1) Procurement confirms signatories and PO due date, 2) we send DocuSign pack for signature (I will prepare), 3) kickoff eval week starting the Monday after signature.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Commercial_Summary_Crestview_RevB.pdf (pdf)]
